title: 第1章 重生第2章 像是一株野草
content_zh:
经开大学，一处池塘边有人溺水，现在正在抢救。
“那不是张逸风吗？”
有人认出了溺水者的身份。
“张逸风，就是那个被打得不能行房事的张家大少爷吗？哎，家道中落，家破人亡，现在又受了这么大打击，看来他是主动寻死啊。”
“如果我是他，估计我也会寻死的。你知道前天发生的事情吗？前天张逸风主动找姜凤，说同意姜凤当他的女友。你知道姜凤当时说什么吗？”
“说什么？”
“姜凤说，就算我答应做你的女朋友，你能和我那个吗？就算我躺在你身边，你也得不到我。”
“我草，这么狠。”
四周是嘈杂的议论声，在这些议论声中，张逸风终于睁开了双眼。
看着四周密密麻麻的人群，张逸风下意识的做出防御动作，却发现他的身体笨重不堪。仔细一看，身旁人穿的衣服非常另类，根本不是灵月大陆的服饰。
“张逸风，你醒了，没事吧？”
一位戴眼镜的同学，声音关切的开口。刚才就是他一直在给张逸风做心肺复苏。
“没事……”
张逸风站起身体，狼狈逃开了这里。
“切，还以为自己是张家大少爷，居然连一声谢谢都不说。”
“还不如让他死了的好。根本不该救他。”
围观的人群一阵起哄。
张逸风离开池塘，看着四周的钢筋建筑，满脸不可思议，这里是哪里？他知道，这里绝不是灵月大陆。
越想，他越觉得脑袋疼，像是有什么东西，要从记忆深处钻出来。
就在这时，那位戴眼镜的同学因为不放心，从身后跟了过来，再次关切的问道：“张逸风，你没事吧？”

“我叫张逸风吗？”
张逸风看向戴眼镜的瘦弱青年，感觉脑袋很疼。

“这里是哪里？”
“你……你不会失忆了吧。这里是经开大学。你是张家大少爷，不对，你的家族已经……”
眼镜少年说到这里，顿了一下，似乎不好意思说出口。
“已经怎么了？”
“已经不存在了。张逸风，身为同学一场，我还是要告诉你，一定要坚强。不能因为受了打击，就寻死。还有那个姜凤，你完全不需要放在心上。姜凤本来就不是好女人。”
姜凤？
张逸风听见这个名字，忽然身体一颤，一些记忆犹如流水一般，涌入脑海。
张逸风终于将一切事情都记起了，这里的确不是人人修仙的灵月大陆，而是地球。
他叫张逸风，张氏集团的大少爷。他有一个妹妹，叫张可新。
张氏集团由他父亲张天河一手开创，张天河是一个孤儿，从孤儿院长大，他一步步创业，最终将张氏集团发展成为全国五百强的集团，集团集合餐饮，住宿，旅游，房地产于一体，事业蒸蒸日上。
但，天有不测风云，一场金融风暴，张氏集团破产了。
张逸风的父亲张天河接受不了打击，跳楼自杀。张逸风的母亲也郁郁而终，张家，只剩下他和妹妹。
现在的他，算得上张家的孤儿。虽然他还有外公，但母亲死后，外公只是派人将他妹妹张可欣接去了文家。总之，现在的张逸风是孤身一人。
没有钱，没有房，也没有女人。
虽然父亲死前曾经给张逸风定下了一门亲事，对方是京都一个大家族的千金小姐。但现在家破人亡，这门婚事多半都黄了。
家庭遭受这样巨大的变故，富二代变穷一代，换做任何人都受不了。张逸风便是其中之一，他开始熏酒，开始惹是生非，最终被人打成了重伤，男人最宝贵的地方也从此失去了作用。
地球的张逸风或许接受不了自己没有女人的事实，前两日做了一件自己打自己脸的事情。他被一个女人狠狠伤了自尊心！

那个女人叫姜凤，读高中的时候就喜欢张逸风，因为那时候的张逸风是张家少爷。
或许是受不了身边无人的打击，张逸风居然主动去找姜凤，说答应让她当自己的女朋友。
content_en:
At Kaikai University, someone drowned near a pond, and rescue operations are underway.
"Isn't that Zhang Yifeng?"
Someone identified the drowning man.
"Zhang Yifeng, is that the eldest young master of the Zhang family who was beaten so hard that he couldn't have sex? Hey, his family was in ruins, his family was ruined, and now he has suffered such a big blow. It seems that he is actively seeking death."
"If I were him, I would probably seek death. Do you know what happened the day before yesterday? The day before yesterday, Zhang Yifeng took the initiative to find Jiang Feng and said he agreed to Jiang Feng being his girlfriend. Do you know what Jiang Feng said at that time?"
"What did you say?"
"Jiang Feng said, even if I agree to be your girlfriend, can you be with me? Even if I lie next to you, you can't get me."
"What a fool, so cruel."
There were noisy discussions all around, and amidst these discussions, Zhang Yifeng finally opened his eyes.
Looking at the dense crowd around him, Zhang Yifeng subconsciously made defensive movements, but found that his body was heavy and heavy. If you look closely, you will see that the clothes worn by the people next to you are very different and not the clothes of Lingyue Continent at all.
"Zhang Yifeng, you're awake, are you okay?"
A classmate wearing glasses spoke with a concerned voice. He was the one who had been performing cardiopulmonary resuscitation on Zhang Yifeng just now.
"It's okay..."
Zhang Yifeng stood up and fled away in embarrassment.
"Tch, I thought I was the eldest son of the Zhang family, but I didn't even say thank you."
"It would be better to let him die. We shouldn't have saved him at all."
The crowd of onlookers booed.
Zhang Yifeng left the pond and looked at the steel buildings around him with a look of disbelief on his face. Where is this place? He knew that this was definitely not Lingyue Continent.
The more he thought about it, the more his head hurt, as if something was trying to come out of the depths of his memory.
At this moment, the classmate wearing glasses came over from behind because he was worried, and asked again with concern: "Zhang Yifeng, are you okay?"
"My name is Zhang Yifeng?"
Zhang Yifeng looked at the thin young man wearing glasses and felt his head hurt.

"Where is this?"
"You...you won't have amnesia, right? This is Jingkai University. You are the eldest son of the Zhang family. No, your family has..."
The boy with glasses paused for a moment when he said this, as if he was embarrassed to say it.
"What's happened?"
"No longer exists. Zhang Yifeng, as a classmate, I still want to tell you that you must be strong. You cannot seek death just because you have been hit. And that Jiang Feng, you don't need to take it to heart at all. Jiang Feng is not a good woman in the first place."
Jiang Feng?
When Zhang Yifeng heard the name, his body suddenly trembled, and some memories poured into his mind like running water.
Zhang Yifeng finally remembered everything. This was indeed not the Lingyue Continent where everyone cultivated immortality, but the earth.
His name is Zhang Yifeng, the eldest son of the Zhang Group. He has a sister named Zhang Kexin.
The Zhang Group was founded by his father Zhang Tianhe. Zhang Tianhe was an orphan who grew up in an orphanage. He started his own business step by step and eventually developed the Zhang Group into one of the top 500 companies in the country. The group integrates catering, accommodation, tourism, and real estate, and its business is booming.
However, something unexpected happened, a financial crisis occurred, and Zhang Group went bankrupt.
Zhang Yifeng's father, Zhang Tianhe, could not bear the blow and committed suicide by jumping off the building. Zhang Yifeng's mother also died in depression, leaving only him and his sister in the Zhang family.
Now he can be regarded as an orphan of the Zhang family. Although he still had a grandfather, after his mother died, his grandfather just sent someone to take his sister Zhang Kexin to the Wen family. In short, Zhang Yifeng is alone now.
No money, no house, no women.
Although his father had arranged a marriage for Zhang Yifeng before his death, the other party was the daughter of a big family in Kyoto. But now that the family is ruined, this marriage is probably ruined.
The family suffered such a huge change,No one can bear it when the second generation of rich people becomes the poorer generation. Zhang Yifeng was one of them. He started to smoke alcohol and cause trouble, and was eventually beaten and seriously injured. The most precious part of a man has since lost its function.
Zhang Yifeng from Earth may not be able to accept the fact that he doesn't have a woman, so he did something that slapped him in the face two days ago. His self-esteem was severely hurt by a woman!
That woman's name is Jiang Feng. She liked Zhang Yifeng when she was in high school, because Zhang Yifeng was the young master of the Zhang family at that time.
Perhaps because he couldn't stand the shock of having no one around him, Zhang Yifeng actually took the initiative to go to Jiang Feng and promised to let her be his girlfriend.
